items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: Simon and Joan was a member of the Buddy Petit Band, jazz band, and it was also myself I played with Buddy Petit.

ctx.x: Can you remember some of the bands he played in? About the only one we can always hear about is the Celestan Band, but do you remember anything about his life at all that he ever told you or that you can remember when you were a little baby, practically, he must have been playing when you were pretty young.

Well, Bill, I do remember him, he played with Sam Morgan's band. I remember that good, and Buddy Petit Band also. Simon and Joan was a member of the Buddy Petit Band, jazz band, and it was also myself I played with Buddy Petit.
We'll talk about that in a minute there.

items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: And he played with Kid Rene and Buddy Pitty.

ctx.x: Played with Solishtan a long time. John Marrera. With P. Ron too, didn't he? Yeah. He played with King Joe Oliver. You remember Joe Oliver? Yeah we had the records.

Yeah. And he played with Kid Rene and Buddy Pitty. And he started you on banjo. He started me on banjo. How I started banjo I picked it up to see my mother, she played guitar. My father was a bass player, which you heard about your knowledge. My brother was a bass player and my brother John was a guitar and a banjo player. But they all really was good and I used to listen to them all the time. And my first instrument was a guitar. My first number was Under the Double Eagle. I remember that and I can't play it…
space. space. Two little strings, second, third space, Littlefinger and the one, two, three, four, fifth.
